scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance
other_conditions: Enterprises must have started production between 01‑01‑2022 and 31‑12‑2024
A four‑party agreement with the Directorate of Textiles, a financial institution and Tantuja must be executed
Units may be private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector, companies/undertakings owned and managed by the State Government, or industrial SHGs
The project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
documents_required: Chartered Accountant certificate (original) as per Annexure‑V
